name: stranger
description: STRANGER — anonymous 1-to-1 text and video chat with safety-first matchmaking

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev -w apps/server & npm run dev -w apps/web & wait
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test -w packages/protocol -w apps/server -w apps/web
